confirmed.title: Focusing the sticky «Почати» button scrolls the 320px setup sheet 10px, cutting its top padding from about 16px to about 6px
confirmed.evidence: The side-by-side still (design on the left, page on the right) shows the «Поле 4×4 / 6×6 / 8×8» size control about 10 CSS px higher in the page capture. Its top border almost touches the sheet's rounded top edge. Iteration 18 copies this into the design: review-set-16/320-light-setup-marked.png and 320-dark-setup-marked.png are the only two CHANGED files in set-16 (AE=172496 and AE=236268). Cropping set-15 against set-16 at y=260..460 shows the gap above the size control shrinking from about 16px to about 6px. root-cause.txt explains why: with `scroll-padding-bottom: calc(2.75rem + 48px)`, focusing `setup-start` moves the sheet from scrollTop 0 to 10, its maximum. «Почати» sits in the sticky footer and is always visible, so the scroll gains nothing; it only eats the top padding. The diff images 320-light-setup-marked-diff.png and 320-dark-setup-marked-diff.png show every block shifted by the same amount (doubled outlines everywhere), so this is a uniform scroll, not a layout change. Nothing is clipped, so the effect is cosmetic, but the reference now treats this shrunken top padding as correct.
confirmed.suggestion: Keep the design and the product matching the product's scroll padding as signed (A-60), but write the side effect down where it will be seen: in the PD-14 or set-16 CHANGES notes, record that the 320 setup-marked stills are taken after the sheet scrolls to its end because the focused button is inside the region the scroll padding reserves. Separately, ask the user whether a focused footer button should scroll the sheet at all. One option is `scroll-margin-bottom: 0` combined with a negative scroll margin on `.setup-start` and `.setup-close`. Another is to apply the bottom padding only to the level options, for example with `scroll-margin-bottom` on `.level-control` options instead of `scroll-padding-bottom` on the sheet. Either keeps the WCAG 2.4.11 protection for the options without moving the sheet when focus lands on a footer button. That would be a signed product change, not something to quietly adjust in the design.
verifierNotes: The mechanism holds up. src/ui/style.css:1064 sets `scroll-padding-bottom: calc(2.75rem + 48px)` on `.setup-sheet:popover-open`.
